node.statement: Pointwise reduction: fix a pivot s, write beta_j=beta_s(j), beta_j^+=max(beta_j,0), lambda_j=lambda_s(j), lambda_j^+=max(lambda_j,0), lambda_j^-=max(-lambda_j,0), and D_+=sum_j beta_j^+ lambda_j^+. Then S*_s(U) <= Phi_s(U)+2D_+. Reason: because P has row sums 1 and p_j=sum_t a_t(j)p_{u_t} while each pivot row also has row sum 1, one has sum_t a_t(j)=1 and hence lambda_j=sum_{t!=s} a_t(j)=sigma_s(j)-mu_s(j). The scalar inequality sigma_s(j)+2lambda_j^- <= E_s(j)+2lambda_j^+ follows by the two cases lambda_j>=0 and lambda_j<0; multiplying by beta_j^+ and summing gives the displayed bound.
